# Lovart AI

> > Lovart is the world's first AI design agent that automates creative workflows from logos to marketing campaigns, enabling designers and businesses to generate professional graphics at scale.

Lovart AI is a comprehensive automated graphic design platform featuring the Nano Banana AI model, specialized tools for image generation and editing, and industry-specific design templates. The platform serves creative professionals, marketers, real estate agents, and e-commerce businesses with AI-powered design automation and brand consistency tools.

- [AI Image Extender - Expand Photo Boundaries](https://www.lovart.ai/tools/ai-image-extender): Lovart AI Image Extender tool for expanding photo boundaries and outpainting.
